vocab.meaning_vi: thực tế so với ngân sách
vocab.example: This table shows actual vs budget for each department in September.
vocab.example_vi: Bảng này thể hiện số thực tế so với ngân sách của từng phòng ban trong tháng Chín.

vocab.example: We had a favourable variance in travel costs because many trips were cancelled.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta có chênh lệch có lợi ở chi phí đi lại vì nhiều chuyến công tác bị huỷ.

vocab.example: The unfavourable variance in marketing came from the new campaign.
vocab.example_vi: Chênh lệch bất lợi ở mảng marketing đến từ chiến dịch mới.

vocab.example: The key driver of higher revenue was the new client in Singapore.
vocab.example_vi: Yếu tố chính khiến doanh thu tăng là khách hàng mới ở Singapore.

vocab.meaning_vi: chi phí nhân sự (theo số lượng nhân viên)
vocab.example: Headcount cost went up because we hired five new developers.
vocab.example_vi: Chi phí nhân sự tăng vì chúng ta tuyển thêm năm lập trình viên.

vocab.meaning_vi: luỹ kế từ đầu quý đến nay
vocab.example: Quarter-to-date, we are about three percent above our sales target.
vocab.example_vi: Luỹ kế từ đầu quý, chúng ta đang vượt mục tiêu doanh số khoảng ba phần trăm.

vocab.example: The outlook for the fourth quarter is positive, but we should watch costs.
vocab.example_vi: Triển vọng quý bốn khả quan, nhưng chúng ta nên theo dõi chi phí.

vocab.example: We will reforecast the year-end numbers after the October results.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta sẽ dự báo lại số liệu cuối năm sau khi có kết quả tháng Mười.

lines.speaker: Mai (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Today I will walk you through the September results.

lines.speaker: Duc (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Thanks, Mai. Let us start with the big picture, please.

lines.speaker: Mai (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Sure. Revenue was 4.2 billion dong, which is five percent above budget.

lines.speaker: Duc (Finance Manager)
lines.text: That is good news. What was the key driver?

lines.speaker: Mai (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Mainly the new client in Singapore. They paid for two projects earlier than planned.

lines.speaker: Duc (Finance Manager)
lines.text: And on the cost side? I see an unfavourable variance in this column.

lines.speaker: Mai (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Yes, headcount cost was higher because we hired five developers in August.

lines.speaker: Duc (Finance Manager)
lines.text: I see. Was that hiring in the original budget?

lines.speaker: Mai (Finance Analyst)
lines.text: Only three of them. The other two were approved later, so we need to reforecast.

lines.speaker: Duc (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Okay. Please prepare a new year-end forecast and send it to me by Friday.

questions.q: How did September revenue compare with the budget?

options: Five developers were hired in August

questions.q: What does Duc ask Mai to do by Friday?

shadowing: Overall, revenue this month was slightly higher than we expected.
The main reason for this increase is the new contract with our Singapore client.
As you can see on this slide, costs are still under control.
We had some extra expenses in marketing because of the new campaign.
I will send the full report with all the details after this meeting.
